# perm_to_lehm_idx! {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
perm_to_lehm_idx!(P::Vector{<:Integer}, used::Vector{<:Integer}) -> Int
```
Version of [`perm_to_lehm_idx`](perm_to_lehm_idx.qmd) without allocations: convert a permutation `P` of `1:n` into its 1-based lexicographic index, using the preallocated work vector `used`.
 
`used` is modified: on return, every entry is `1`. Reset it with `fill!(used, 0)` before the next call. `P` is not modified.
 

### Arguments

  * `P`: a permutation of `1:n`, for example the result of `sortperm`.
  * `used`: work vector of length `n` whose entries are all zero on input.

### Returns

  * The index of `P`, an integer in `1:factorial(n)`.

### Examples


```julia
used = zeros(Int, 3)
StatsOrdinalPatterns.perm_to_lehm_idx!([3, 1, 2], used)  # 5
fill!(used, 0)  # required before the next call
```


:::
